title: Orb photo showing Chris's lost child

tellings.quote: fact, I have a child. My wife and I lost a child. We have four, but we lost a child. And I was out thinking about him. And um this lonely orb there it comes [snorts] and I took a picture of it and and there was a child.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he draws UFOs to him and whom NASA has studied, says he took a picture of a lone glowing ball of light and found a child in it. He tells it himself: he and his wife lost one of their children, and he was outside thinking about that son when "this lonely orb" came, and the photo showed "a child." If true, it would mean the lights he sees are tied to his lost son.
